# The Autumn Weaves

> A small weaving shed in Galashiels, Scottish Borders, selling wool throws, bed blankets and lambswool scarves by post, in four colourways: bracken, rowan, heather and peat.

## Pieces and prices (GBP)
- Herringbone throw, 130 × 180 cm: £98
- Twill throw, 130 × 180 cm: £92
- Bed blanket, single: £135
- Bed blanket, double: £165
- Bed blanket, king: £195
- Lambswool scarf, 30 × 180 cm: £48
- Yarn colour card: £3

Contact: loom@theautumnweaves.com. No mill tours or weaving classes, no clan patterns to order, no synthetic blends, no upholstery fabric by the metre.
